title: Minimum value by completing the square
source: Theory P1-1.6 Quick check 1 (min of x^2-8x+7 is -9); book Worked example 1.13 style pp.18-19, new numbers
stem: By completing the square, find the minimum value of \(x^2-{B|int}x+{c|int}\).

steps.name: A
steps.note: The square is at least 0, so the minimum is c-h^2. Derived key is V, not M, so it does not clash with a method step name.

contexts.note: Includes the original h=4, c=7, min=-9

title: x-coordinate of a turning point
source: Theory P1-1.6 Quick check 2 (turning point of 2x^2-12x+5 has x=3); book Key point 1.3 style p.20, new numbers
stem: Find the \(x\)-coordinate of the turning point of \(y={a|int}x^2-{B|int}x+{d|int}\).

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The axis of symmetry is \(x=\dfrac{ {B|int} }{ 2\times {a|int} }={h|int}\), so the \(x\)-coordinate of the turning point is \({h|int}\).

contexts.note: Includes the original a=2, h=3, d=5, matching 2x^2-12x+5

title: Maximum value by completing the square
source: Theory P1-1.6 Quick check 3 (max of 15-2x-x^2 is 16); book Worked example 1.14 style p.20, new numbers
stem: By completing the square, find the maximum value of \({c|int}-{B|int}x-x^2\).

steps.name: A
steps.note: The square is at least 0, so the maximum is c+m^2. Derived key is V, not M.

contexts.note: Includes the original c=15, m=1, max=16

title: Express a quadratic in completed-square form

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2015), Question 1. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 9709/13/M/J/15 Question 1, taken from the official QP.

Express \(2x^2-12x+7\) in the form \(a(x+b)^2+c\), where \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) are constants.  [3]

steps.name: B1
steps.note: MS: B1 B1 B1 for 2, (x-3), and -11 (3 marks). The factor 2 is the value of a.

steps.name: B2
steps.note: MS: B1 for the (x-3) bracket, equivalent to b=-3 in the form a(x+b)^2+c.

steps.name: B3
steps.note: MS: B1 for -11. The printed scheme also lists the equivalent reading a=2, together with the values from 2(x-3)^2-11. Independent check: 2(x-3)^2-11=2(x^2-6x+9)-11=2x^2-12x+18-11=2x^2-12x+7.
